text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho proves to be an
insurmountable
wall, but Rudolf still has
her pride. She will
demonstrate her
unbreakable determination at
the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Нарита Брайан, who was
watching the
race, comes by the waiting
room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Their terse conversation ends with some
pointed
remarks from Brian about
Rudolf's insistence on
keeping up her
student council duties.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
